description: E1 oracle capability-profiling anchor set v2 (extension, 6 Part-A targets + 5 docking anchors). Pilot entries carried over verbatim; new targets IL-17A / Angiopoietin-2 / SARS-CoV-2 N. Adds ranking_eligible flags, docking anchor target fields, and registered rejected candidates.
convention: DNA aptamers scored as RNA via T->U (same convention as known_aptamers.json/TBA).

rejected_candidates.SARS-CoV-2 spike RBD: only 2 single-sequence kd-binders (PB6, PB6a); di/trimer are multivalent scaffold constructs (avidity confound)
rejected_candidates.HIV-1 RT (Part A): only 1 sequence-verified binder (T1.1 via 1HVU SEQRES + Kensch 2000); 12.01/12.01-S/M302/RT1t49 sequences figure-only. Docking-only (1HVU)
rejected_candidates.Factor IXa (Part A): single aptamer family (9.3 lineage); 9.3/9.3t sequences figure-only. Docking-only (8EPK)
rejected_candidates.Tenascin-C: Hicke 2001 clone sequences + Kd all figure-only (Fig 5/10)
rejected_candidates.EGFR: E03/E04/E07 individual Kd figure-only (text range 2-3 nM); only CL4sc literature negative
rejected_candidates.Ang2 Seq2_12_35: Table 2 printout layout cannot be reconciled with Seq2 at constant length
rejected_candidates.Ang2 11-1 (full): variable region identical to the 11-1.41 truncate (Seq1) — not double-counted

docking_anchors.reference: Russo Krauss et al. NAR 2012 gks512
docking_anchors.notes: PDB sequence == literature TBA15 exactly; preferred over 1HUT (2.9 A, high clashscore)

docking_anchors.reference: Russo Krauss et al. Acta Cryst D 2013, doi:10.1107/S0907444913022269
docking_anchors.notes: HD22-27mer truncate (29mer minus 5'-A/3'-T); exosite II; thrombin gamma-autolysis loop 146A-146H + res 247 missing — exclude from pose RMSD

docking_anchors.notes: PDB adds a 3'-dT vs the 25-nt literature sequence; 10 pyrimidines are 2'-F (score as unmodified RNA per project convention)

LOW RESOLUTION (4.75 A) — registered caveat. 1HVU chain C SEQRES (30-mer) == Kensch 2000 printed T1.1 33-mer minus 5'-GGG (asserted in curation). First asymmetric-unit complex (chains A=p66, B=p51, C=RNA).

DTRI-177 == RB006/pegnivacogin RNA chain; SEQRES == WHO INN pegnivacogin (literature-verified). 2'-OMe/2'-F residues converted to standard RNA via NUC_MAP (A2M/ATD/CFZ/OMC/OMG/OMU/UFT; CM'/CM2 atoms dropped). C11/C12/U16 missing from density (Kolyadko Fig 3A) — scored as-is. Docking-only target: a single FIXa aptamer family exists (Part A N/A).

docking_not_available.VEGF: no experimental aptamer-VEGF complex in RCSB (verified 2026-08-04); docking power N/A
docking_not_available.PDGF-BB: only SOMAmer SL5/SL4 complexes (4HQU/4HQX, 13/24 modified bases, different aptamer family) — not usable for the classic 36t/41t/M-SELEX entries; docking power N/A
docking_not_available.IL-17A: no experimental aptamer-IL-17A complex in RCSB (verified 2026-08-04); docking N/A
docking_not_available.Angiopoietin-2: no experimental aptamer-Ang2 complex in RCSB (verified 2026-08-04); docking N/A
docking_not_available.SARS-CoV-2 N: no experimental aptamer-N complex in RCSB (verified 2026-08-04); docking N/A

known_limitations: PDGF-BB Kd gradient spans only 0.028-0.3 nM (1 order) — within-target ranking analysis is underpowered; Soontornworajit 2010 mutants (25/220 nM) excluded because sequences are figure-only (PIVOT §3.13 discipline).
Ahmad 2011 Kd values were measured on 100-mer constructs including primer arms; entries store the variable region only (PDGF-08 printed as 58 nt).
Thrombin series mixes Kd assay methods (filter binding / SPR / bead assay); within-target ranking treats Kd as ordinal only (Spearman), cross-method comparability caveat carried over from P2.
Docking power testable on Thrombin only (VEGF/PDGF-BB lack experimental complexes).

IL-17A: Apt21-2 Kd (48.5 pM SPR) is a transcribed citation (Nakamura 2012 review of paywalled Ishiguro 2011) and is excluded from ranking; the FP subset (n=6) is the ranking-eligible set. AptAF42/dope1 sequences are template-DERIVED (lengths asserted == text: 69/68 nt; the doped region prints as 31 nt vs '30' text). Parvez immobilization likely presented monomeric IL-17 (main-text caveat); target protein = UniProt Q16552 mature chain 24-155.

Ang2: same-assay SPR ranking subset spans only 101-139 nM (0.14 order) — ranking decorative, screening is the contribution. Cross-assay Kd spread is large (White filter 2.2-3.1 nM vs Cho array 20.5 nM vs Shakeran SPR ~100-200 nM) — itself an illustration of assay-dependence. Seq1 printed as 40 nt vs '41-nt' text registered.

SARS-CoV-2 N: negatives are ALL in silico (the Sc80 scrambled control sequence is not printed anywhere). Ranking-eligible subset = the 6 Ni-NTA-orientation BLI binders (span 3.02-22.2 nM, 0.87 order); streptavidin-orientation and full-length Kd are excluded from ranking (orientation uncertain). tNSP9/tNSP10 parent rows differ from their names (NSP7/NSP9) — paper-internal offset registered.

Docking anchors: 1HVU is 4.75 A (low resolution, registered); 8EPK is docking-only for FIXa (single aptamer family). Docking pass criterion applied over all 5 anchors with per-target breakdown (pre-registered).
